findings.problem: V1 accepted any rejection reason, including unrelated failures; treated empty array as accepted.
findings.action: V2 matches expected reason substring, treats unexpected result as error; positive control required. Other simultaneous rejection reasons may still coexist; no proof of isolated cause.

findings.problem: Validator normalizes input, including battle-only forms and abilities; v1 ignored normalization when judging match.
findings.action: V2 records original/normalized input and requires unchanged selected core fields for positive cases. Level, gender and other fields not compared; JSON property order may produce conservative false discrepancy. Extend before general legality use.

findings.problem: Existence and full learnset union are not registered legality. V1 lacked explicit output scope and referenced rules.
findings.action: V2 labels universe, preserves direct/full learnset, source codes, event data, form fields, valueRules and complex bans including Infinity. Validator callbacks remain in pinned source; export is not standalone complete legality model.

findings.problem: V1 only checks HEAD and tracked cleanliness; stale compiled tree possible.
findings.action: V2 hashes dist files before/after execution, records manifest, still requires independently documented clean build from fixed source and dependencies; compiled digest does not prove source equivalence. No installed dependency hashing or sandbox enforcement.

findings.problem: V1 could emit empty tables and duplicate IDs or broken references without explicit detection.
findings.action: V2 checks nonempty tables, unique IDs, selected cross references and learnset exceptions; any issue blocks clean exit. Some nonstandard rows may legitimately produce issues and need classification; no complete reference audit.

findings.problem: Initial test cases omit several boundary and joint restrictions.
findings.action: V2 adds one-move and zero-move cases, total 17 planned. Seven-member case duplicates a species but count branch returns first in pinned source; not isolated in general. Need valid controls for form/stone/ability interactions, multi-Mega registration, distinct same-species forms, and joint move/source restrictions as applicable. Not exhaustive.

acceptance: Not approved. Run in existing isolated local environment with clean build provenance; preserve full artifacts locally, review errors and normalized values, no production integration. V1.1 provisional game authority does not imply simulator input guard is real game rule.
other: No changes to approved mathematics or PV/OCR/HP hold. Global ledger not updated. No raw images or secrets transferred.
